function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a shell command in the workspace directory.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file or list directory entries within the workspace.

path.description: Relative path to file or directory within workspace

limit.description: Max lines/entries to return. Default: 200. Max: 2000

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a new file within the workspace.

path.description: Relative path of the new file.

overwrite.description: Allow overwriting an existing file. Default: false.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace a string in an existing file. Fuzzy matching is applied automatically.

path.description: Relative path to the file to edit

old_string.description: String to replace. Empty string = append mode.

new_string.description: Replacement, or content to append when old_string is empty.

function.name: glob
function.description: List files in the workspace matching a glob pattern.

pattern.description: Glob pattern relative to workspace root.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search for a pattern across files in the workspace.

pattern.description: Search pattern. Regex by default (unless literal=true).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the whole workspace.

literal.description: Treat pattern as a literal string. Default: false.
